# Nigeria Construction Rate Book - full data (Buildocrat)

Prices as at 6 October 2026. Abuja base, naira (NGN), excluding VAT unless stated. Source: Buildocrat Property Technologies Ltd (RC 7019619), https://rates.buildocrat.store. Licence CC BY 4.0.

Method: unit rate = sum(material qty x (1+waste) x price) + sum(labour hours x all-in hourly rate) + sum(plant days x all-in day rate). Tender rate = net x 1.3347 (overheads 7.5%, contingency 5%, profit 10%, VAT 7.5%).
